app.name: EasyPostman
app.one_liner: An open-source API debugging & performance testing desktop app inspired by Postman and simplified JMeter, built with Java for offline, privacy-first developer workflows.

screens.name: Main Workspace
screens.purpose: Primary interface for managing API collections, environments, and sending requests with response inspection and performance testing capabilities.

rust_commands.name: load_git_workspace
rust_commands.purpose: Initialize and load a workspace from a local Git repository for version-controlled collaboration.

rust_commands.name: resolve_environment_variables
rust_commands.purpose: Parse and substitute environment and global variables in request fields, supporting standard naming conventions.

rust_commands.name: send_http_request
rust_commands.purpose: Execute an HTTP request with configured method, headers, body, and authentication, respecting redirect settings.

mvp_plan: week 1: Build local workspace persistence layer
week 1: Design main screen layout with request editor and response viewer
week 1: Implement core HTTP client with redirect control
acceptance_tests: Application launches successfully on Windows, macOS, and Linux (including Wayland)
Environment variables with underscore names are correctly resolved
Git workspace loads and syncs API collections via local repository
HTTP requests execute correctly with proper error handling
Redirects can be disabled and the setting is respected
